about_the_game:
Shogun Pinball – The Path of the Warrior!

A samurai’s fate is forged in steel and honor. In Shogun Pinball, every shot carves your destiny—will you serve with honor or embrace the path of betrayal? Your journey through feudal Japan is not just about high scores; it’s a test of loyalty, strategy, and combat mastery as you battle your way to the Shogun’s Castle.

🏯 The Path to the Castle – Honor or Betrayal?

Before you can challenge the Shogun’s Castle, you must choose your path. Every mission, every decision, and every ramp you hit determines whether you walk the noble path of a samurai, or the treacherous road of a ronin.

⚔️ Two Paths, Two Fates:

  • Bushido Path (Honor): Serve your lord faithfully, defend villages, and duel with honor to prove your worth as a true samurai.

  • Ronin Path (Dishonor): Betray your master, raid strongholds, and strike from the shadows to forge your own destiny.

Once your fate is sealed, the gates to the Shogun’s Castle open—but standing in your way are three formidable boss battles.

👹 The Three Boss Battles – The Road to Power

Each boss battle is a unique pinball combat challenge, requiring skillful shots and strategic gameplay to defeat.

🔥 Boss 1 – The Daimyo Warlord

  • A powerful feudal lord who tests your skill in a siege battle.

  • Hit ramps and bumpers to weaken his army before striking the castle gates to bring him down.

  • Honor warriors fight for the clan, while dishonored players assassinate him in the night.

⚡ Boss 2 – The Shadow Ninja Clan

  • A stealth-based battle where the playfield goes dark with only flickering torches to guide you.

  • Hit the hidden targets and trap lanes to reveal and eliminate the ninja assassins.

  • Samurai defend the temple, while Ronin steal the ancient secrets.

🏯 Boss 3 – The Shogun’s Castle

  • The final multi-ball war where you storm the Shogun’s keep.

  • Honor-bound samurai must fight through enemy ranks, while dishonored warriors may challenge the Shogun himself for the throne.

  • Choose your fate: Bow in service, or seize ultimate power?

🔥 Features & Game Mechanics

🎯 Karma Meter: Your honor or dishonor shapes the missions, bonuses, and even the final battle.

🌀 Spinning Dojo Arena: A rotating combat stage for duels and training challenges.

💥 Multi-Ball War Mode: Representing the chaos of battlefield clashes.

🎶 Immersive Soundtrack: Taiko war drums, shakuhachi flutes, and intense samurai battle sounds.

🏆 Online Leaderboards: Compete globally to prove your supremacy as the greatest warrior!

Will You Serve… or Seize the Throne?

Shogun Pinball is more than just a game—it’s a journey of choice, combat, and consequence. Choose wisely, fight bravely, and claim your place in history!

🔥 Step into the battle – Your fate awaits! 🔥

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunger
